notes.title: Patch #4 Pathing generation update
notes.notes: This patch changes the way enemy paths are generated. The paths will now have more interesting and varied shapes

notes.title: Cosmic egg update
notes.notes:
The cosmic egg will now create galaxies faster, the galaxies upon hit will break off into smaller galaxies. The audio menu will also now save user audio settings.
Audio options have been added to the main menu and the ui has been updated as well

notes.title: Audio menu update
notes.notes: Adds volume slider in options menu

notes.title: Post release patch 3
notes.notes: This changes the mechanics for how crits work to increase the crit increase per stack of glowing to be an increase of 5% per stack instead of one. It also shifts the pitch for critical hits and increases the magnitude of the damage wiggle for enemies undergoing a crit.

notes.title: Post release bugfix and game balance update
notes.notes:
Wow has it already been two whole days since launch. Thank you everyone who has supported the game so far. 

MK ULTRA Psychic Defense's first post release update is here and it fixes the following.


Towers no longer are slowed when firing at enemies after a death.
Enemy spawning waves have a set size now meaning that the time taken to defeat a wave will no longer be overly long. 



More updates coming soon.
